comment: Hand-written capture and layout settings for scripts/generate-reference-shots.py. Keys are '<source path>::<symbol>' (or just '<symbol>'). Everything here is optional; omit an entry to take the defaults (480x360 still, laid out as a two-column row with the image on the left). 'motion' shoots a GIF instead of a still — only for symbols whose meaning cannot be read from a single frame (ADR-0008: DocC cannot use WebP, so motion costs a GIF). 'layout': 'stack' puts the code above the image at full width — for wide figures and for snippets whose lines do not fit a column.
